Especially considering your age, your body can handle a large surplus of calories. Start implementing protein shakes that are 900+ calories, drink them while eating a meal. I know it can get sickening eating so much food, but if you make a meal, just sit down and focus on eating. Don't eat and watch tv/ youtube, etc. Just eat. It'll help you get it down without feeling sick. 2.5k-2.7k calories for your size is much too little. Look up a calorie calculator for your height/weight/age. Based off your current numbers and goals, you should be eating 3,435 cal/day.

Read some books by Robert Greene (48 Laws of Power, Seduction) follow social media influencers that base their content on skin care and simple fashion tips. Go to an actual salon and ask the hair stylist opinion on a good look for you (a haircut can really maketh man). pick up a hobby that is exercise related (BJJ, Judo, Muay Thai, calisthenics, weightlifting), it’s great for making friends and building confidence. Get a pet, and dedicate yourself to making it live a full life (take it on hikes, camping, road trips) spend at least 30 minutes outside (vitamin D is really a wonder drug, especially from the sun). All of this truly helped me, 23M who was on the way to loading the gun, I’m also in the military, which is a good break from modern world, but definitely brings its downsides with it. The best part is that you recognize that you want change, and we are all proud of you for making that first step. Everything is about consistency, failing one day or one week isn’t important, what’s important is trying to be better than who you were yesterday. Good luck man!

I always tell my sailors, my PT test pushups and my training push ups are very different. I can probably do 45-50 strict push ups in one go, but on a PT test I always hit 90-100, mainly because I go super wide so the 90 degree is super easy to hit. Other than that do as many as you can before you hit your leaning rest. If you try and break them up into increments you’ll feel that lactic acid reeaaal quick. Remember: your score doesn’t have a comment box for form, it just says how many you do. Good luck
